verdict.rationale: Hightouch's warehouse-native design means customer data stays in the customer's own warehouse or S3 bucket. That leaves retention and deletion in the customer's hands rather than Hightouch's ([hightouch-comm-3], [hightouch-docs-44], [hightouch-docs-5]). CDC also sends removed rows downstream, which can carry deletions to destinations ([hightouch-docs-58], [hightouch-docs-25]). This control is only implied by the architecture, not offered as a documented feature. Missing for 10: documented retention-period settings, deletion/erasure (GDPR/CCPA) request APIs or workflows, controls over Hightouch-side logs/metadata retention, and AI/MCP-driven deletion control.
